description: Draw Secret Santa (gift exchange) pairs: everyone gives to exactly one other person and receives from one, never themselves. Exclusions (couples, housemates…) block a pair both ways. Checks exactly whether a draw is possible and explains why not (and which exclusion to drop). Crypto random and uniform; optional seed. Up to 200 people. Nothing is emailed: hand each giver only their own line. Optional budget, date and message are echoed for slips. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/secret-santa/

exclusions.description: Pairs of names who must not draw each other, e.g. [["Omar","Sara"]].

names.description: Participants (an item may also hold several names separated by commas or new lines).

seed.description: Optional seed for a reproducible result (same seed + same input = same output). Omit for true crypto randomness.
